name: ui-review
description: Review a website or app interface through 13 UI lenses (visual hierarchy, CTA prominence, imagery and icons, layout and grid, spacing rhythm, typography scale, colour and contrast, dark mode, brand coherence, design-system consistency, responsive behaviour at 360/768/1280, motion, perceived performance) with measured values and annotated screenshots; deliver a visual report and a hands-off brief for AI agents with selectors and current vs target values.
